name: evaluation-ecosystem-data
description:
AI Evaluation Ecosystem Simulation Dataset
	

Hugging Face dataset repository: evaluation-ecosystem/evaluation-ecosystem-data.
Simulation outputs supporting the AI Evaluation Ecosystem paper. Each run is a stochastic
simulation of an AI evaluation ecosystem (providers, evaluators, consumers, regulators,
funders, media) over 40 monthly rounds. This release contains 119 LLM-mode runs (agent policies: claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-5.5-2026-04-23) and 250 heuristic-mode runs… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/evaluation-ecosystem/evaluation-ecosystem-data.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. All actors (providers, evaluators, consumers, regulators, funders, media) are synthetic. No real persons or organizations are represented; provider names (Mirage, Spark, OpenCore, Orion, etc.) are fictional.
rai:dataLimitations: Simulation data, not real-world ecosystem observations. Six fixed providers, no entry/exit; single global jurisdiction; 40-round horizon; three LLM agent policies (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.5) plus a heuristic baseline; six-dimensional capability ontology and hand-calibrated consumer need-weights are researcher-imposed structural choices. Mechanism applies to leaderboard-driven, public-benchmark-dominated competitive contexts; not validated for FDA-style gatekeeping, defense procurement, or enterprise B2B contexts.
rai:dataBiases: Six-dimension capability ontology (reasoning, coding, knowledge, safety, communication, agentic) is anchored to HELM/LMSYS taxonomies and where industry investment is currently separable; alternative ontologies could shift results. Consumer need-weights derive from US-centric labor-market data (NBER 2024, Stanford AI Index 2025, McKinsey 2024-2025); non-US ecosystems may differ. LLM-driven actor reasoning may inherit biases from the underlying foundation models.
rai:dataUseCases: Validating systems-perspective analyses of AI evaluation; studying mechanism behavior under benchmark privacy and holdout-design choices; comparing LLM-driven vs heuristic agent behavior in multi-actor games; testing structural ablations (no_incidents, no_funders, no_regulator, etc.); cross-model robustness comparisons across LLM agent policies.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Intended to inform AI evaluation policy design (governance, benchmark composition, holdout protocols). Should not be used to make claims about specific real-world AI providers, products, or markets — provider names and market dynamics are illustrative simulation artifacts. Misuse could occur if results are read as forecasts of real-market behavior; the simulator is a hypothesis generator, not a predictive model.
prov:wasGeneratedBy: Generated by the AI Evaluation Ecosystem simulation (source code: anonymized GitHub URL withheld during double-blind review). LLM-mode runs use Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6, and OpenAI GPT-5.5 (snapshot 2026-04-23) as agent policies for provider, regulator, funder, and media actors; heuristic-mode runs use deterministic rule-based agents. Each run is 40 monthly rounds; full SimulationConfig is captured in per-run config.json.
prov:wasDerivedFrom: Calibration of the simulator draws on published real-world data: Stanford AI Index 2025 (benchmark landscape), NBER Bick/Blandin/Deming 2024 (AI task adoption), McKinsey State of AI 2025, HELM/LMSYS benchmark taxonomies, Epoch within-family benchmark correlations. The dataset itself is synthetic simulation output, not a transformation of any source dataset.

distribution.name: runs.jsonl
distribution.description: Per-run registry with provenance and headline metrics. One JSON line per simulation run.

recordSet.name: runs
recordSet.description: Per-run registry: one record per simulation run with provenance and headline metrics.

field.name: tier
field.description: Tier label assigned during organization of the staging dir.

field.name: bucket
field.description: Top-level bucket: core_privacy, core_evaluator_capture, exogenous_validation, structural_ablations.

field.name: model
field.description: LLM model identifier (LLM-mode only). One of: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6, gpt-5.5-2026-04-23.

field.name: condition
field.description: Experimental condition (e.g., baseline, private_only, no_incidents, evaluator_capture, ev1_deepseek_shock).

field.name: seed
field.description: Stochastic seed used for the simulation run.

field.name: path
field.description: Repo-relative path to the per-run directory.

field.name: git_commit
field.description: Git commit SHA of the simulation source code that produced the run.

field.name: created_at
field.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the run was produced.

field.name: hhi_final
field.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of provider market shares at the final round.

field.name: mean_satisfaction_final
field.description: Population-mean consumer satisfaction at the final round.

field.name: mean_score_final
field.description: Cross-benchmark mean published score at the final round.

field.name: mean_gap_unweighted_final
field.description: Unweighted mean per-benchmark score-satisfaction gap at the final round.

field.name: mean_gap_shareweighted_final
field.description: Market-share-weighted mean per-benchmark score-satisfaction gap at the final round.

field.name: safety_share_final
field.description: Share-weighted mean of provider safety-investment allocations at the final round.

field.name: llm_fallbacks
field.description: Count of LLM-call fallbacks (heuristic-rule substitutions) within the run; LLM-mode only.
